normalization: L/Up is an advective time scale. Uniform-cell arithmetic mean equals volume mean. Cross-Ra dimensionless comparability does not prove a common numerical floor or acceptable threshold.

boundary_handling.internal: owner plus phi; neighbour minus phi
boundary_handling.physical_walls: add stored boundary phi, without forcing it to zero
boundary_handling.limitations: hard-coded single-block patch order and uniform volume; not a general nonuniform polyMesh implementation

Ra_zero_handling: Up=0 returns None; proposed undefined/NOT_APPLICABLE epsilon_phi, Gate C absolute velocity/conduction checks, no arbitrary Up floor.
pressure_residual_definition: PCG: R_initial=||b_s-A_s*p0||_1/Np; R_final=||r_recursive||_1/Np. Np=sum_i(abs((A_s*p0)_i-a_bar_i)+abs(b_s_i-a_bar_i))+1e-20; a_bar=(A_s*1)*arithmetic_global_mean(p0). Np fixed within one solve.
pressure_stopping_condition: R_final<tolerance OR (relTol>1e-20 AND R_final<relTol*R_initial). Convergence/maxIter/singularity must be distinguished.
direct_mapping_field_interpretation: No unconditional usable mapping from reported normalized residual or configured tolerance alone. Conditional symbolic relations were derived separately below.

conditional_mapping.physical_identity: q=b0-A0*p_star, for volume-integrated physical pressure matrix and matching boundary/explicit correction flux, before pressure relaxation.
conditional_mapping.ideal_relation: epsilon_phi=Kp*R_final with Kp=L*Np/(Up*V_total), only with true=recursive residual and no reference/operator/output mismatch.
conditional_mapping.closed_single_reference_bound: epsilon_phi <= L/(Up*V_total)*(2*Np*R_final + 2*E_recursive + abs(B_net_boundary) + E_other), provided nonreference rows and flux are consistent, with remaining defects included in E_other.
conditional_mapping.absolute_tolerance_use: Substitute tolerance only after confirmed absolute convergence (relTol=0 suffices to disable relative stopping). Active relative stopping uses max(tolerance,relTol*R_initial). No configured-tolerance bound for failed solves.
conditional_mapping.saved_pressure_caveat: Corrected phi uses unrelaxed p_star; saved p_rgh is relaxed and may be gauge-shifted. Saved p_rgh alone cannot generally reproduce the pressure solve residual.

native_continuity.cumulative: sum over iterations of signed global
native_continuity.mapping: epsilon_phi=(L/Up)/deltaT*sum_local only for matching state, field and numerical precision
native_continuity.recommended_role: diagnostic cross-check, not an unqualified replacement Hard metric
native_continuity.steady_deltaT_caveat: iteration management scale; not a physical time-integration error proof

decision_tree.A: Not supported: no independent transferable numerical tau.
decision_tree.B: Not sufficient: operator-only verification does not determine solver mapping or physical budget.
decision_tree.C: Primary: quantitatively verify tolerance-to-flux mapping including reference, true residual drift and serialization.
decision_tree.D: Possible if local and absolute budgets should become Hard; not formally adopted.
